label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new export tool on Windows likely saves CSV files with CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings. Since `parser.ts` splits lines purely on `\n`, the trailing carriage return (`\r`) remains attached to the last field of every line and header, causing column count mismatches and "Malformed row" errors.
